name: Renew the mail apps certificate through the relay
description: On a site whose mail arrives through a relay, mail programs connect to the relay's name and the mail gateway here holds a certificate for it, issued through the relay. Once a day, when that certificate has fewer than 30 days left, a new key is made here and the relay obtains the new certificate for it. Does nothing on a site that reaches mail programs directly (certbot renews that certificate) or with mail apps off.
